items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ritter Place is a little street that one of the great jazz singers, Maxine Sullivan, lived on that street.

ctx.x: Before that, let’s just move back a little bit, where did you go to elementary school?

I went to elementary school P.S. 99 on Stevens Avenue and Home Street. I then went to junior high school at junior high school 40, which was at Prospect Avenue and Ritter Place. Ritter Place is a little street that one of the great jazz singers, Maxine Sullivan, lived on that street.
That’s what we were trying to remember—Ritter Place!
